mapper.insert: INSERT INTO waitlists (user_id, game_id, waitlist_status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{gameId}, 'BEING_WAITING')
INSERT INTO group_waitlists (user_id, game_id, waitlist_status, number_of_people) VALUES (#{userId}, #{gameId}, 'BEING_WAITING', #{numberOfPeople})
mapper.select: SELECT game_id, game_datetime, home_team, away_team, is_cancelled, is_ended, stadium FROM games WHERE is_cancelled = FALSE AND is_ended = FALSE AND game_datetime > NOW()

SELECT game_datetime, home_team, away_team, stadium FROM games WHERE game_datetime >= NOW() AND game_datetime <= NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days' AND is_cancelled = false AND is_ended = false ORDER BY game_datetime ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE games SET is_ended = true where game_datetime < NOW();
